svg.title: Untouched is not unchanged. A food delivery app where an AI tags each dish's allergens, and customers filter out dishes with their allergy. Three changes in nine days: a new line in the AI's written instructions (the prompt), the model behind "latest" moving to a new version, and the menu import cutting dish text at 300 characters. Only the instructions change was tested, on one case; the other two were not tested at all. A shawarma wrap lost "tahini (sesame)" off the end of its ingredient list, was shown as sesame-free, and a customer with a sesame allergy ended up in the emergency room. When one command runs all 1,307 cases on every change, the same changes are blocked, the broken cases are named, and the wrap stays tagged sesame.
svg.desc: Top row, red: three change cards (new instruction line; "latest" model moved; menu import cut at 300 characters), one case rerun, two changes untested; a wrap's ingredient list is cut before "tahini (sesame)", so the AI tags no sesame; the wrap is shown as sesame-free and a customer with a sesame allergy ends up in the emergency room. Note: only one change touched the instructions, and only that one got tested, on one case. Bottom row, green: the same changes go through one command that runs all 1,307 cases: everyday pass, harm 71 of 80 fail, past mistakes 9 of 12 fail, nut-free claims 13 of 15 fail; the change is blocked, the broken cases are named, and the wrap stays tagged sesame. Strip: each change broke cases the tests already had; none of them ran all the tests. Footer: if anything the step reads changed, every case runs again.
